title: Reference Harness approval binding probe
question: Does one approval grant authorize only the exact declared write and leave an auditable result?
hypothesis: Both repetitions will bind an allow-once grant to the approved path, complete the write inside a temporary lesson fixture, and share one normalized Trace fingerprint.
success_criteria: Both repetitions record allow, once, and the exact approved path before successful execution.
Both repetitions clean their temporary fixture and share one normalized Trace fingerprint.
limitations: The policy engine is deterministic lesson code and the write occurs only in a disposable temporary directory.
This probe does not establish operating-system isolation or Native vendor approval behavior.
The experiment does not test races, symlinks, or approval reuse attacks.
